$comment: Environment variables removed with no deprecation window. check:ci-removed-env-vars (.ci/scripts/quality/check_removed_env_vars.py) fails on any tracked occurrence of a name below, in console or an initialized submodule, outside the `excluded` entries (a path prefix, or an fnmatch pattern when it holds `*`). Each entry must still match a tracked path. Add a name here in the commit that removes its last reader; never remove one.

removed.name: REDIACC_ALLOW_CONFIG_EDIT
removed.reason: the override let an agent rewrite the whole config, including the policy that limits it, delete repo entries whose LUKS credential then exists nowhere, and skip the --current proof on secrets; it is removed completely, with no alias

excluded.agent/ledgers/: append-only ledgers record what happened, including the removal
excluded.agent/worklist: the worklist store and its legacy markdown record the work items that removed the name
excluded.agent/reviews/: per-commit review records quote the diffs that removed the name
excluded.agent/programs/remote-mcp/: the program's decision record (D17) is where the removal is decided
excluded.agent/plans/: plan files are the record of the removal; PLAN-rmcp-config-edit-removal.md names the variable in its title
excluded.packages/www/public/search-index: generated from the docs and blog corpus at build time; the pages it is built from are scanned
excluded.packages/www/src/content/blog/*/remote-m: the one post announcing the removal, in each locale (PLAN-rmcp-docs.md D17 and Design 2)
